{{Quote|Place your bets, ''gentlebeings! ''Six-to-one'' odds on Old One-Eye!|italics=0|Droid announcer at an illegal rancor fight on Coruscant|<ref name="PC" />}}
'''Old One-Eye''' was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] with only one [[Eye/Legends|eye]] who was a contender in an illegal rancor fighting circuit on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] entered the rancor [[Coruscant gladiatorial arena|arena]] while [[Mission to Coruscant (Anakin Skywalker)|pursuing]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] agent [[Raice Liq]], and Tano was forced to fight Old One-Eye. Skywalker resolved the situation by [[Animal bond|calming]] Old One-Eye with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], allowing the Jedi to use the rancor in apprehending their quarry.

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's ''no way out'' of the arena. I'm going to have to&hellip; ''fight!''|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="PC" />}}
[[File:OldOneEyeAndTheOtherOne-TCWCUK611p11.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=In a dusty fighting pit, Ahsoka Tano crouches low to the ground with her lightsaber drawn as Old One-Eye and another rancor loom over her.|Old One-Eye and another rancor face Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano.]]
Old One-Eye was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="PC" /> Between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Prize Contender]]" takes place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which started in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', and depicts [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which she left during the events of "[[The Wrong Jedi]]," which took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] per {{FactFile2014|42|20 BBY 51-54|Jedi Temple bombing}}.</ref> during the war, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and<ref name="PC" /> his<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], went [[Mission to Coruscant (Anakin Skywalker)|undercover]] at an illegal rancor fight featuring Old-One Eye on<ref name="PC" /> the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TNEC" /> of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], about eighty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. They aimed to stop [[Raice Liq]], a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who used the fights to transfer Republic munitions data to the Separatists.<ref name="PC" />

The fight pitted Old One-Eye against another rancor with six-to-one odds in favor of Old One-Eye according to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] announcer. Tano fell into the [[Coruscant gladiatorial arena|arena]] during the match and had to fight Old One-Eye and the other rancor, with Old-One Eye grabbing her and dropping the Padawan into its [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]  as Skywalker quickly joined the fight as well. Although the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] had no effect on the rancors' tough hides, Skywalker was able to [[Animal bond|calm]] the beasts through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], allowing Tano to climb out of Old-One Eye's maw. Before calling [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to bring [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and additional [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to assist in arresting the 200 law-breaking [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]], Tano mounted Old One-Eye while Skywalker mounted the other rancor to go after Liq. After the arrival of the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], the Jedi approached Liq on rancors and arrested him.<ref name="PC" />

==Personality and traits==
Old One-Eye had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and a scar through its left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] by [[Time/Legends|time]] it encountered Ahsoka Tano.<ref name="PC" />

==Equipment==
While fighting in the arena on Coruscant, Old One-Eye had a chain pierced through its lower lip and wore a pair of gray [[Bracer/Legends|bracers]].<ref name="PC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Old One-Eye appeared in "[[Prize Contender]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] written by [[Rik Hoskin]] and illustrated by [[Tanya Roberts]], that was published by [[Titan Magazines]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.11|eleventh issue of the sixth volume]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|'' Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic]] magazine series<ref name="PC" /> on [[August 19]], [[2010]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.10|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.10]]</ref>
